---
title: "Under the Hood"
---

Between the call and the trajectory, a scenario becomes a covariate vector, a boosted tree
becomes a smooth monotone response, and a sixteen-column tensor is pushed through a
state-space network. None of that is needed to use the stack. All of it matters if you are
extending it.

::: {.chapter-outline}
- [Pipeline architecture](architecture.qmd) — the order of operations inside `run_scenarios`.
- [estiMINT internals](estimint-internals.qmd) — the model bundle, the calibrator, the monotone sweep.
- [stateMINT internals](statemint-internals.qmd) — the Mamba2 backbone, the input tensor, the target transforms.
:::
